title: Almost-sure uniqueness of the Gaussian location NPMLE
summary: For Gaussian location mixtures with identity covariance, we prove that the nonparametric maximum likelihood estimator of the mixing distribution is unique for Lebesgue-almost every dataset, for every sample size and dimension. In particular, uniqueness holds almost surely whenever the joint distribution of the observations is absolutely continuous. The proof uses the finite-support theorem for Gaussian location NPMLEs and almost-everywhere differentiability of the optimal log-likelihood.
